rationale: Three minutes after the open, the bid-ask spread is very wide at 31.6 bps ($0.46), which represent nearly 77% of the 5-minute ATR ($0.60) and creates a severe immediate execution disadvantage. Entering short at the exact low of the day after a $2.50 drop from the open carries poor reward-to-risk, while going long against strong downward momentum below VWAP ($147.12) lacks structural support.
